Allergies, health and food safety

  • Always check ingredient labels for allergens. The allergen notes in our recipes are a guide and may be incomplete.
  • If you have allergies, a health condition, are pregnant, or have special dietary needs, speak to a qualified professional before relying on a recipe.
  • You are responsible for cooking food safely, including washing hands, avoiding cross-contamination, cooking food through, and storing and reheating it properly. Our cues and timings are guides. Your equipment, ingredients and kitchen may differ, so use your own judgement.
  • Take care with knives, heat, hot oil and appliances.
